answer: The glacier holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
